title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十六章、出宫

    在张怀的追杀下，马超抱着孩子跳江死了。伤心的楚珠决定回宫，她躲在运水车队的水桶里悄悄进了宫。
    包拯问她：“你回去后见到李妃娘娘了吗？”
    楚珠点头说：“见到了，娘娘还在那个小库房里，蓝香和她在一起。娘娘睡着了，我看着虚弱的娘娘，心里有了个大胆的想法。我不能让娘娘不明不白地死在那个破旧的小库房里，我要带娘娘出宫去。救火的运水车队还要出宫，我可以带着娘娘坐运水车出去，就算被发现了也没关系，最坏的结果不就是死吗？反正留在小库房也是死，为什么不试一下？如果成功了，我就可以带娘娘去个安静的地方啊！”
    “你成功了吗？”包拯问。
    “成功了。”楚珠脸上露出了笑容，她说：“我背着娘娘出了小库房，我们躲在一辆装满空桶的运水车里，没有人检查出宫的运水车，我们出宫了。”
    “出宫后你把娘娘带到哪儿去了？无人岛吗？”包拯问。
    “对，我带娘娘去了无人岛。”楚珠点头说：“我从小在宫里长大，小时候听宫里的老宫女说过，南湖的无人岛是个没有人的地方，我觉得那一定是个安静的好地方。我带娘娘去了南湖，那时候天刚亮，太阳出来了。娘娘醒了，她看着阳光下的无人岛，说那真是一个好地方，她愿意死在那儿。湖边有船，我把娘娘背上船，划着船去了无人岛。”
    “无人岛上那个无名木碑的坟墓里埋着谁？”包拯问得很是艰难。
    楚珠的眼泪又流下来了，她的悲伤更重了：“蓝香从太医院拿了很多药，但娘娘的伤太重了，连药也喝不下去了，上岛后的第三天就去世了。我把娘娘埋在了岛上，没有在木碑上写名字，我不想让别人发现那儿。”
    包拯看向站在八王爷后面的公孙策，公孙策也远远地看着他，四目相对，两个人的表情都是沉重而悲伤。虽然他们猜对了，但这个结果还是让人难以接受。
    “这么多年你都是一个人孤独地住在岛上吗？为什么不离开呢？”包拯问。
    “我没有觉得孤独，也没有想过要离开，因为娘娘在那儿。”
    “好的，楚珠，这些事情我都清楚了。现在你能告诉我，你为什么绑架八王爷吗？”
    “我绑架八王爷是为了让包大人您来查案。”
    “事情已经过去二十一年了，为什么决定现在查案呢？”
    楚珠停了一下，深吸一口气说道：“因为今年中秋节，我发现自己可能犯了一个天大的错误。”
fullText.traditional:
第三十六章、出宮

    在張懷的追殺下，馬超抱著孩子跳江死了。傷心的楚珠決定回宮，她躲在運水車隊的水桶裡悄悄進了宮。
    包拯問她：“你回去後見到李妃娘娘了嗎？”
    楚珠點頭說：“見到了，娘娘還在那個小庫房裡，藍香和她在一起。娘娘睡著了，我看著虛弱的娘娘，心裡有了個大膽的想法。我不能讓娘娘不明不白地死在那個破舊的小庫房裡，我要帶娘娘出宮去。救火的運水車隊還要出宮，我可以帶著娘娘坐運水車出去，就算被發現了也沒關係，最壞的結果不就是死嗎？反正留在小庫房也是死，為什麼不試一下？如果成功了，我就可以帶娘娘去個安靜的地方啊！”
    “你成功了嗎？”包拯問。
    “成功了。”楚珠臉上露出了笑容，她說：“我背著娘娘出了小庫房，我們躲在一輛裝滿空桶的運水車裡，沒有人檢查出宮的運水車，我們出宮了。”
    “出宮後你把娘娘帶到哪兒去了？無人島嗎？”包拯問。
    “對，我帶娘娘去了無人島。”楚珠點頭說：“我從小在宮裡長大，小時候聽宮裡的老宮女說過，南湖的無人島是個沒有人的地方，我覺得那一定是個安靜的好地方。我帶娘娘去了南湖，那時候天剛亮，太陽出來了。娘娘醒了，她看著陽光下的無人島，說那真是一個好地方，她願意死在那兒。湖邊有船，我把娘娘背上船，划著船去了無人島。”
    “無人島上那個無名木碑的墳墓裡埋著誰？”包拯問得很是艱難。
    楚珠的眼淚又流下來了，她的悲傷更重了：“藍香從太醫院拿了很多藥，但娘娘的傷太重了，連藥也喝不下去了，上島後的第三天就去世了。我把娘娘埋在了島上，沒有在木碑上寫名字，我不想讓別人發現那兒。”
    包拯看向站在八王爺後面的公孫策，公孫策也遠遠地看著他，四目相對，兩個人的表情都是沉重而悲傷。雖然他們猜對了，但這個結果還是讓人難以接受。
    “這麼多年你都是一個人孤獨地住在島上嗎？為什麼不離開呢？”包拯問。
    “我沒有覺得孤獨，也沒有想過要離開，因為娘娘在那兒。”
    “好的，楚珠，這些事情我都清楚了。現在你能告訴我，你為什麼綁架八王爺嗎？”
    “我綁架八王爺是為了讓包大人您來查案。”
    “事情已經過去二十一年了，為什麼決定現在查案呢？”
    楚珠停了一下，深吸一口氣說道：“因為今年中秋節，我發現自己可能犯了一個天大的錯誤。”

sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā men cāi duì le dàn zhè ge jié guǒ hái shi ràng rén nán yǐ jiē shòu
sentences.english: Although they had guessed correctly, this result was still hard to accept.

sentences.simplified: “这么多年你都是一个人孤独地住在岛上吗？为什么不离开呢？”包拯问。
sentences.traditional: “這麼多年你都是一個人孤獨地住在島上嗎？為什麼不離開呢？”包拯問。
sentences.pinyin: zhè me duō nián nǐ dōu shì yí ge rén gū dú de zhù zài dǎo shang ma wèi shén me bù lí kāi ne bāo zhěng wèn
sentences.english: “Have you been living alone on the island all these years? Why didn’t you leave?” Bao Zheng asked.

sentences.simplified: “我没有觉得孤独，也没有想过要离开，因为娘娘在那儿。”
sentences.traditional: “我沒有覺得孤獨，也沒有想過要離開，因為娘娘在那兒。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu jué de gū dú yě méi yǒu xiǎng guò yào lí kāi yīn wèi niáng niang zài nà'r
sentences.english: “I didn’t feel lonely, nor did I think about leaving, because the noble consort was there.”

sentences.simplified: “好的，楚珠，这些事情我都清楚了。现在你能告诉我，你为什么绑架八王爷吗？”
sentences.traditional: “好的，楚珠，這些事情我都清楚了。現在你能告訴我，你為什麼綁架八王爺嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: hǎo de chǔ zhū zhè xiē shì qing wǒ dōu qīng chu le xiàn zài nǐ néng gào su wǒ nǐ wèi shén me bǎng jià bā wáng ye ma
sentences.english: “Okay, Chu Zhu, I understand all these things now. Now can you tell me, why did you kidnap the Eighth Prince?”

sentences.simplified: “我绑架八王爷是为了让包大人您来查案。”
sentences.traditional: “我綁架八王爺是為了讓包大人您來查案。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bǎng jià bā wáng ye shì wèi le ràng bāo dà ren nín lái chá àn
sentences.english: “I kidnapped the Eighth Prince to make you, Lord Bao, investigate the case.”

sentences.simplified: “事情已经过去二十一年了，为什么决定现在查案呢？”
sentences.traditional: “事情已經過去二十一年了，為什麼決定現在查案呢？”
sentences.pinyin: shì qing yǐ jīng guò qù èr shí yī nián le wèi shén me jué dìng xiàn zài chá àn ne
sentences.english: “It’s been twenty-one years since the incident. Why did you decide to investigate now?”

sentences.simplified: 楚珠停了一下，深吸一口气说道：
sentences.traditional: 楚珠停了一下，深吸一口氣說道：
sentences.pinyin: chǔ zhū tíng le yí xià shēn xī yì kǒu qì shuō dào
sentences.english: Chu Zhu paused for a moment, took a deep breath, and said, ..

sentences.simplified: “因为今年中秋节，我发现自己可能犯了一个天大的错误。”
sentences.traditional: “因為今年中秋節，我發現自己可能犯了一個天大的錯誤。”
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi jīn nián zhōng qiū jié wǒ fā xiàn zì jǐ kě néng fàn le yí ge tiān dà de cuò wù
sentences.english: .. “Because during this year’s Mid-Autumn Festival, I realized that I might have made a huge mistake.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 36: Leaving the Palace
With Zhang Huai in pursuit, Ma Chao jumped into the river, holding the child, and died.
The brokenhearted Chu Zhu decided to return to the palace.
She sneaked into the palace by hiding in a barrel in a convoy of water carts.
Bao Zheng asked her, “Did you see Consort Li after you returned?”
Chu Zhu nodded and said, “I saw her. The noble consort was still in that small storeroom. Lan Xiang was with her.
The noble consort had fallen asleep. As I looked at the frail noble consort, a bold idea came to my mind.
I could not let the noble consort die unjustly in that shabby little storeroom.
I intended to take the noble consort out of the palace.
The convoy of water carts that was fighting the fire still needed to leave the palace.
I could bring the noble consort out on a water cart.
Even if we were discovered, it didn’t matter. The worst outcome would just be death, right?
Anyway, staying in the small storeroom would also mean death, so why not give it a try?
If I succeeded, I could take the noble consort to a quiet place!”
“Did you succeed?” Bao Zheng asked.
“I did succeed.” A smile appeared on Chu Zhu’s face.
She said, “I carried the noble consort out of the small storeroom on my back.
We hid in a water cart filled with empty barrels.
No one checked the water carts leaving the palace, so we made it out.”
“Where did you take the noble consort after leaving the palace? To the uninhabited island?” Bao Zheng asked.
“Yes, I took the noble consort to the uninhabited island.”
Chu Zhu nodded and said, “I grew up in the palace.
When I was a child, I heard from the old palace maids that the uninhabited island in the South Lake was a place without people.
I thought that it must be a good and quiet place.
I took the noble consort to the South Lake. At that time, the sky was just getting light, and the sun had risen.
The noble consort woke up. She looked at the uninhabited island under the sunlight.
She said it was truly a wonderful place, and she would be willing to die there.
There was a boat by the lake. I carried the noble consort onto the boat and rowed to the uninhabited island.”
“Who is buried in the grave with the unnamed wooden stele on the uninhabited island?” Bao Zheng asked with great difficulty.
Tears streamed down Chu Zhu’s face again, her sorrow deepening:
“Lan Xiang brought a lot of medicine from the Imperial Academy of Medicine, but the noble consort’s injuries were too severe.
She couldn’t even take the medicine, and she passed away on the third day after we arrived on the island.
I buried the noble consort on the island.
I didn’t write her name on the wooden steele because I didn’t want anyone to discover that place.”
Bao Zheng looked at Gongsun Ce, who was standing behind the Eighth Prince. Gongsun Ce was also looking at him from a distance.
Their eyes met, and both of their expressions were heavy and sorrowful.
Although they had guessed correctly, this result was still hard to accept.
“Have you been living alone on the island all these years? Why didn’t you leave?” Bao Zheng asked.
“I didn’t feel lonely, nor did I think about leaving, because the noble consort was there.”
“Okay, Chu Zhu, I understand all these things now. Now can you tell me, why did you kidnap the Eighth Prince?”
“I kidnapped the Eighth Prince to make you, Lord Bao, investigate the case.”
“It’s been twenty-one years since the incident. Why did you decide to investigate now?”
Chu Zhu paused for a moment, took a deep breath, and said, ..
.. “Because during this year’s Mid-Autumn Festival, I realized that I might have made a huge mistake.”
